format: Each case: ArtifactThreeWayMerge.merge(base, mine, theirs) = expect, either {merged: text} or {conflict: true}. Lines are the text split on the character \n with empty pieces kept; changes to different lines merge, the same or adjacent lines changed on both sides are a conflict, identical changes are one change, and a side equal to base yields to the other.

cases.name: trailing newlines and blank lines survive the merge
one side empties the body, the other edits it: conflict
appends on both sides at the end are a conflict
an edit to the first line and an append at the end merge
CRLF line ends: the Mac splits on the character \n, and \r\n is one character, so a CRLF body is one line and both edits touch it
unicode lines merge like any other
